title: Register desktop connection bootstrap
responsibility: Registers the single IPC operation that supplies a trusted renderer with its local socket connection details.

inputs.name: desktopIpc.port
inputs.description: The IPC handler registry, providing handle and removeHandler operations.

inputs.name: desktopIpc.bootstrap
inputs.description: A callback that checks the caller and returns its local connection bootstrap, or null for an untrusted caller. Trust checking is delegated to this callback.

outputs.name: desktopIpc
outputs.description: A cleanup function that removes the bootstrap handler. Project operations themselves use the socket supplied by the bootstrap.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The registered request rejects with Untrusted renderer when the bootstrap callback returns null. Callback and handler-registration failures can also propagate.
